reason: The aluminium already comes with factory film, and tape and film cost me well under a euro per m². Paying about €19 per m² for something I don't buy today is not going to happen on small house and block jobs.
objection: €19/m² is many times what I pay for film and tape, and the factory film already covers the frames. I'd need a new budget line and a new supplier for a problem I don't have.
instead: Keep the factory film on the aluminium, add cheap protection film and tape where needed, and have the crew take care on site.
would_change_my_mind: Proof, with a named Maltese contractor reference, that it saves more in claims and replacement than it costs, at a price close to €3 per m² all-in.
